topic: Compare prices for shampoo bottles over the years taking into account their volume
kindReason: The topic asks which shampoo bottles give the best value across volumes, so each option's total cost over the period is compared.
title: Shampoo bottle prices over the years, by volume
summary: Compares the shelf prices of popular shampoo brands and bottle sizes sold in Singapore over recent years, converted to price per 100ml. Assumes SGD retail prices from major supermarkets and pharmacies, with a bottle bought once a year at the price of the year.
